scope: The Dark: four ordinary nonbasic lands and three gold cards. No per-printing rendering parameters.
policy: Frozen scan-only affine pose graph before source selection; disjoint boundary strips and texture checks, synthetic pose recovery. Original small training/reserved groups retained. Numerical region evidence does not certify typography or complete-set accuracy. Source stock is inherited; canonical scan stock is not remeasured.

normalization.policy: Actual raster replay of the mean-centered pose graph, without any renderer or self-reference. Every directed pair is checked on independent art/rules outlines and side texture. Interior art/rules replacement leaves extracted profiles identical; additionally replacing the title leaves fitted transforms identical. Synthetic translation/scale/rotation/shear recovery is an additional probe, not a card holdout.

geometry.policy: Same frozen native boundary support and independent texture strips as source selection; no refitting. Seven-card census, original small training/reserved cohort. Color distances are Oklab x100, boundary/texture values are correlations, not whole-card correctness. No hosted score uploads. Per-component held-out color improves on every card; some texture contrast and tint differences remain. Stock inherited, not remeasured.
reviewQueue: All seven cards still need title, type, rules, mana/set symbol, credit and stat coverage. Maze of Ith rules text is substantially undersized.
Land art bevel and thin outer stock outline retain small source geometry/intensity differences.
Maze of Ith has a warmer/lighter scan than the shared land target; independent art keyline error remains 6.14 Oklab x100 despite improving from 22.11.
Gold fit has only one training name and two reserved names; do not transfer to other sets without validation.
